pages.text: Divine Sense is used to detect the souls of other players within your detection range. $(br)If your detection stength is greater than the other players detection resistance thier soul will be highlighted for you to see. $(br2)When you progress enough in divine cultivation you can press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.divine_sense) to activate divine sense.

$(br2)Pressing shift while divine sense is active will highlight nearby mobs if your detection stength is high enough. $(br2)If you are crouching while divine sense is active, nearby cultivation resources will be highlighted.
